title: Profile editor and UDP fallback

controls.label: Profile config
controls.action: Shows the toolbar and the preference list for one profile. The activity closes at once when the intent profile id is neither -1 nor the stored editing id.

controls.label: Close (X icon)
controls.action: Toolbar home-as-up with the ic_navigation_close icon. Calls onSupportNavigateUp, which finishes the editor directly and does not run the unsaved-changes guard.

controls.label: Settings list
controls.action: Scrollable preference list that holds the profile fields in three categories. It is the RecyclerView that PreferenceFragmentCompat inflates inside the android:id/content FragmentContainerView; its own id is androidx.preference.R.id.recycler_view.

controls.label: Remove
controls.action: Opens the delete confirmation dialog. Keyboard shortcut d.

controls.label: Apply
controls.action: Saves the draft into the profile row and closes the editor. Keyboard shortcut s.

controls.label: Profile Name
controls.enabled_when: the profile subscription status is not Active
controls.action: Opens the text dialog for the profile name. The summary shows the stored name.

controls.label: Server Settings
controls.action: Category header for the transport fields.

controls.label: Server
controls.enabled_when: the profile subscription status is not Active
controls.action: Opens the text dialog for the server host. The summary shows the stored host.

controls.label: Remote Port
controls.enabled_when: the profile subscription status is not Active
controls.action: Opens a numeric text dialog capped at five digits. The summary shows the stored port.

controls.label: Password
controls.enabled_when: the profile subscription status is not Active
controls.action: Opens the custom password dialog. The summary shows one bullet per password character.

controls.label: Encrypt Method
controls.enabled_when: the profile subscription status is not Active
controls.action: Opens a single-choice menu with 22 method labels. The summary shows the selected label.

controls.label: Feature Settings
controls.action: Category header for the routing and feature fields.

controls.label: Route
controls.action: Opens a single-choice menu with seven routes. The summary shows the selected route label.

controls.label: IPv6 Route
controls.action: Toggles the profile ipv6 flag. The summary reads Redirect IPv6 traffic to remote.

controls.label: Apps VPN mode
controls.action: Starts the Apps VPN mode screen on every change and marks the draft dirty when it turns on. The summary reads Configure VPN mode for selected apps.

controls.label: Metered Hint
controls.visible_when: the system API level is 28 or higher
controls.action: Toggles the profile metered flag. The summary reads Hint system to treat VPN as metered.

controls.label: Remote DNS
controls.action: Opens the text dialog for the remote resolver. The summary shows the stored value.

controls.label: Plugin
controls.action: Category header for the plugin and UDP fallback fields.

controls.label: Plugin
controls.enabled_when: the profile subscription status is not Active
controls.action: Opens the plugin chooser. The summary shows the selected plugin label or the unknown-plugin text.

controls.label: Configure…
controls.enabled_when: the selected plugin entry exists and is not Disabled, and the profile subscription status is not Active
controls.action: Opens the plugin's own configuration activity, or the built-in options editor when the plugin has none. The summary shows the options text.

controls.label: UDP Fallback
controls.enabled_when: the profile subscription status is not Active
controls.action: Opens the UDP Fallback screen. The summary shows the fallback profile's formatted name, which is the name or host:port when the name is empty, or Disabled.

controls.label: Changes not saved. Do you want to save?
controls.visible_when: the system back is pressed while the draft is dirty
controls.action: Asks whether to save the draft before leaving.

controls.label: Yes
controls.action: Reports BUTTON_POSITIVE, which saves the draft and closes the editor.

controls.label: No
controls.action: Reports BUTTON_NEGATIVE, which closes the editor and keeps the stored profile unchanged.

controls.label: Cancel
controls.action: Dismisses the dialog with no listener, so the editor stays open.

controls.label: Are you sure you want to remove this profile?
controls.visible_when: the Remove menu item is tapped
controls.action: Asks whether to delete the edited profile.

controls.label: Yes
controls.action: Deletes the profile row and closes the editor.

controls.label: No
controls.action: Dismisses the dialog with no listener, so nothing is deleted.

controls.label: Password
controls.action: Edits the password in a masked, monospace field with a reveal toggle.

controls.label: Dialog message
controls.visible_when: never; the framework sets android:id/message to GONE because the preference sets no dialog message
controls.action: Message line above the field. It is hidden, not empty: the layout contains the view and PreferenceDialogFragmentCompat hides it when no dialog message is set.

controls.label: Password
controls.action: Single-line password field in monospace, prefilled with the stored password.

controls.label: Show password
controls.action: TextInputLayout end icon that reveals or masks the typed password.

controls.label: OK
controls.action: Writes the typed password into the draft store.

controls.label: Cancel
controls.action: Closes the dialog and keeps the stored password.

controls.label: Edit text
controls.visible_when: a text preference row is tapped: Profile Name, Server, Remote Port, or Remote DNS
controls.action: Standard single-field edit dialog titled with the preference name. Remote Port uses the numeric five-digit filter. Configure… does not use this dialog.

controls.label: Text value
controls.action: Holds the current value, prefilled with the cursor at the end. Remote Port accepts digits only and stops at five characters.

controls.label: OK
controls.action: Writes the typed text into the draft store.

controls.label: Cancel
controls.action: Closes the dialog and keeps the stored value.

controls.label: Encrypt Method
controls.visible_when: the Encrypt Method row is tapped
controls.action: Single-choice menu of 22 entries from NONE to CAMELLIA-256-CFB; the chosen value is stored.

controls.label: Route
controls.action: Single-choice menu: All, Bypass LAN, Bypass mainland China, Bypass LAN & mainland China, GFW List, China List, Custom rules.

controls.label: UDP Fallback
controls.action: Lists the fallback choices. The activity closes at once when the private store holds no editing id.

controls.label: Close (X icon)
controls.action: Finishes the chooser and returns to the editor.

controls.label: Fallback profiles
controls.action: Single-choice list. It scrolls to the current fallback entry when one is set.

controls.label: Disabled
controls.visible_when: always; it is the first row
controls.action: Clears the fallback: stores null, marks the draft dirty, and finishes the chooser. It is checked when no fallback is set, and the tap still writes null and marks the draft dirty when it is already checked.

controls.label: Profile name or address
controls.visible_when: the profile subscription status is not Obsolete, it is not the edited profile, and its plugin selection is empty
controls.action: Shows the profile's formatted name, which is its name or host:port when the name is empty. Stores this profile id as the fallback, marks the draft dirty, and finishes the chooser. It is checked when it is the current fallback.

controls.label: Toolbar
controls.action: MaterialToolbar included from toolbar_light_dark.xml. Shows the editor title and the close navigation icon, and hosts the Remove and Apply menu items.

controls.label: Profile config
controls.action: Shows the activity label Profile config as the toolbar title.

controls.label: Toolbar
controls.action: MaterialToolbar included from toolbar_light_dark.xml. Shows the chooser title and the close navigation icon.

controls.label: UDP Fallback
controls.action: Shows the title UDP Fallback that the activity sets on the toolbar.

controls.label: <profile name icon>
controls.action: Shows the static ic_social_emoji_symbols drawable that the Profile Name row declares.

controls.label: <server icon>
controls.action: Shows the static ic_hardware_router drawable that the Server row declares.

controls.label: <remote port icon>
controls.action: Shows the static ic_maps_directions_boat drawable that the Remote Port row declares.

controls.label: <password icon>
controls.action: Shows the static ic_settings_password drawable that the Password row declares.

controls.label: <encrypt method icon>
controls.action: Shows the static ic_notification_enhanced_encryption drawable that the Encrypt Method row declares.

controls.label: <route icon>
controls.action: Shows the static ic_maps_directions drawable that the Route row declares.

controls.label: <IPv6 route icon>
controls.action: Shows the static ic_image_looks_6 drawable that the IPv6 Route row declares.

controls.label: <Apps VPN mode icon>
controls.action: Shows the static ic_navigation_apps drawable that the Apps VPN mode row declares.

controls.label: <metered hint icon>
controls.action: Shows the static ic_device_data_usage drawable that the Metered Hint row declares.

controls.label: <remote DNS icon>
controls.action: Shows the static ic_action_dns drawable that the Remote DNS row declares.

controls.label: <configure icon>
controls.action: Shows the static ic_action_settings drawable that the Configure… row declares.

controls.label: <UDP fallback icon>
controls.action: Shows the static ic_maps_360 drawable that the UDP Fallback row declares.

transitions.event: the user changes any draft field except Apps VPN mode
the user turns Apps VPN mode on or picks a plugin
the user turns Apps VPN mode off, so AppManager.onCreate sets proxyApps true and marks the draft dirty
the profile list opens the next editor and Profile.serialize removes Key.dirty
the user picks a plugin other than Disabled
the plugin package is removed while the editor is open, so initPlugins runs and the selected entry becomes null
transitions.producer: ProfileConfigFragment.onAttach package change receiver and initPlugins

transitions.event: the user taps a profile row
the user taps a profile row, including the row that is already checked
the user taps the Disabled row
the user taps the Disabled row while no fallback is set, which writes null again and marks the draft dirty
the editor opens a profile whose subscription status is Active
the user leaves the editor with the transport rows untouched
the editor is opened again while the service mode is Proxy only or Transproxy
the editor is opened again while the service mode is VPN

flows.name: Open a profile in the editor

steps.label: start: the user taps the edit control on a profile row
steps.next: system: ProfilesFragment.startConfig calls profile.serialize and starts the activity with the profile id

steps.label: system: ProfilesFragment.startConfig calls profile.serialize and starts the activity with the profile id
steps.next: decision: does the intent carry a profile id other than -1 and other than the stored editing id? yes → the editor finishes, no → the form shows

steps.label: decision: does the intent carry a profile id other than -1 and other than the stored editing id? yes → the editor finishes, no → the form shows
steps.next: no -> system: the form shows the draft values in three categories | yes -> end: the activity finishes before drawing the form

steps.label: system: the form shows the draft values in three categories
steps.next: system: IPv6 Route and Apps VPN mode are enabled only in VPN mode, and an Active subscription disables the transport rows

steps.label: system: IPv6 Route and Apps VPN mode are enabled only in VPN mode, and an Active subscription disables the transport rows
steps.next: end: the editor waits for input

steps.label: end: the editor waits for input
end: the activity finishes before drawing the form

exceptions: The intent carries a profile id that is not -1 and differs from the stored editing id, so the activity finishes at once.

A profile row deleted after the list drew it makes the edit control throw on ProfileManager.getProfile(item.id)!! before startConfig runs, and the subscription control returns early; the editor never opens on a stale row.

flows.name: Apply the edited profile

steps.label: start: the user changes one or more fields
steps.next: system: each change writes the private draft store and marks the draft dirty

steps.label: system: each change writes the private draft store and marks the draft dirty
steps.next: decision: the user taps Apply or presses back and taps Yes? yes → saveAndExit runs, no → the editor closes without saving

steps.label: decision: the user taps Apply or presses back and taps Yes? yes → saveAndExit runs, no → the editor closes without saving
steps.next: yes -> system: Profile.deserialize reads the draft, trims the host, and normalizes the port | no -> end: the editor closes and the stored profile is unchanged

steps.label: system: Profile.deserialize reads the draft, trims the host, and normalizes the port
steps.next: system: ProfileManager.updateProfile writes the row and the list row refreshes

steps.label: system: ProfileManager.updateProfile writes the row and the list row refreshes
steps.next: decision: the profile is the selected profile or its UDP fallback, and direct boot is enabled? yes → DirectBoot.update, no → finish

steps.label: decision: the profile is the selected profile or its UDP fallback, and direct boot is enabled? yes → DirectBoot.update, no → finish
steps.next: yes -> system: DirectBoot.update rewrites the device profile | no -> end: the editor closes and the list shows the saved values

steps.label: system: DirectBoot.update rewrites the device profile
steps.next: end: the editor closes and the list shows the saved values

steps.label: end: the editor closes and the list shows the saved values
end: the editor closes and the stored profile is unchanged

exceptions: ProfileManager.updateProfile uses check on the update count, so a row deleted meanwhile throws IllegalStateException.
Profile.deserialize uses check on the id, so an editing id mismatch throws IllegalStateException.

flows.name: Leave with unsaved changes

steps.label: start: the user presses system back
steps.next: decision: is the draft dirty? yes → the unsaved dialog shows, no → the editor closes with no dialog

steps.label: decision: is the draft dirty? yes → the unsaved dialog shows, no → the editor closes with no dialog
steps.next: yes -> system: the unsaved dialog shows Yes, No, and Cancel | no -> end: the editor closes with no dialog

steps.label: system: the unsaved dialog shows Yes, No, and Cancel
steps.next: decision: which button does the user tap? yes → save and close, no → the other buttons

notes: Every file in the unit list exists. Labels come from core/src/main/res/values/strings.xml and plugin/src/main/res/values/strings.xml, and the toolbar layout is plugin/src/main/res/layout/toolbar_light_dark.xml. The route arrays are in mobile/src/main/res/values/arrays.xml; the core arrays file holds enc_method_entry and enc_method_value. The OK and Cancel buttons of the text dialogs are the framework buttons of androidx.preference 1.2.1 (core/build.gradle.kts:101, gradle/libs.versions.toml:23), so the custom password layout replaces only the field area; the framework sources are the /tmp/pref121 entries in sources_read. The toolbar X calls onSupportNavigateUp and, with no parent activity declared, finishes at once, so it discards a dirty draft while system back asks; rule R-UC-35 records that asymmetry. The plugin chooser sheet, the plugin options editor, its ? help alert, the untrusted warning, and the options-error snackbar belong to U08; U03 records only the Plugin and Configure… rows that open them. The AppManager screen belongs to U07. The editor and the chooser both include toolbar_light_dark.xml, and each preference row carries the static icon that pref_profile.xml declares. The scrollable preference list is the RecyclerView that PreferenceFragmentCompat inflates with id recycler_view; android:id/content in layout_profile_config.xml is only the fragment container. Untrusted-plugin detection reads Android package signatures, which has no counterpart on HarmonyOS. HarmonyOS parity: ProfileEdit.ets implements the IPv6 switch (enabled only in VPN mode), the UDP fallback row, the Remove action with its confirmation dialog, the Profile config title, the close glyph that discards the draft, the five-digit numeric port field whose saved value normalizeRemotePort clamps to 1 through 65535, a load gate that closes the editor when the profile id does not resolve, newManualProfile for the manual add flow, and isSubscriptionLocked for Active subscription profiles. pages/UdpFallback.ets is the chooser: the Disabled row first, then eligibleFallbacks (not obsolete, not the edited profile, no plugin), scrolled to the current choice, with the choice handed back through AppStorage. model/UdpFallback.ets holds the eligibility, display, row-index, and handoff rules, and model/Diagnostics.ets holds ipv6SwitchEnabled. Limits: a manual profile starts with AES-256-GCM, not Android's AES-256-CFB, because the core runs AEAD ciphers only (TC-U03-02); the method menu holds six AEAD presets plus a custom field, not Android's 22 entries (TC-U03-13); the plugin rows use the built-in obfs-local and v2ray-plugin catalogue, with no installed-package discovery or package display label (TC-U03-15, TC-U03-25); the password is an inline masked field with the platform reveal control, not a row summary of one bullet per character (TC-U03-29). Apps VPN mode and the app picker belong to U07, so TC-U03-11 stays missing in this unit's tags. The plugin options editor and its validation, and the ? help, belong to U08, so TC-U03-16 and TC-U03-26 stay missing in this unit's tags. Plugin signatures and package install or removal have no HarmonyOS counterpart (TC-U03-17, TC-U03-30). udp_fallback is still neither imported nor exported by ProfilesFile.ets, and the core config has no fallback key, so the stored choice does not change the tunnel. Device E2E has not run.
